explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem is about the library's own axiomatic `IncidenceGeometry` class and its predicates `SameSide`, `OnLine` and `B` (betweenness). Mathlib has no such synthetic incidence-geometry framework. The proof uses only the library's own lemmas (`diffside_of_B_offline'` and `not_online_of_sameside`), so all of the mathematical content comes from the library's definitions. I did not search Mathlib because there is nothing in it that would apply to these definitions: Mathlib's notions (`Wbtw`/`Sbtw`, `AffineSubspace.SSameSide`) work in affine spaces and do not apply to an abstract `IncidenceGeometry` instance.
